# iosxe_voice_class_e164_pattern_map (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class E164 Pattern Map configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_e164_pattern_map" "example" {
  tag = 200
  patterns = [
    {
      pattern = "+1408.......T"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class e164-pattern-map tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) e164 pattern map specific description
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `patterns` (Attributes List) Set E164 pattern for the map (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patterns))
- `url` (String) Set the URL of the file for the map

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--patterns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patterns`

Required:

- `pattern` (String) Add an E164 into the map

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_e164_pattern_map.example "<tag>"
```
